title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
author: Anthropic
description: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards. Here, we outline how we’ve continued to strengthen these safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.
summary: Earlier this year, we shared an update on our election safeguards , which described how we measure and prevent political bias, detect misuse, and direct people to accurate voting information. Below, we outline how we've built on that work and continued to strengthen our election safeguards ahead of this year’s US midterms.
takeaways: That’s why we test our models extensively for political bias before every model launch.
How people use Claude for elections and politics Our goal is for Claude to be a useful tool for political conversations, while preventing election-related abuse.
To do this, we used Anthropic Insights to develop a new analysis of 250,000 conversations over the course of a recent one-week period.
